```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
```

## Parameters

```{r}
###
### SOIL PARAMETERS
###

N_s <- 0.005              # soil N (kg N m-3)

# Soil diffusion coefficient (m2 s-1)
D <- 1e-9                 # replace with soil-type-specific value
# Area-based uptake (kg N m-1 s-1) used for depletion radius
u_c <- 2e-8               # TODO: find real value

# Depletion radius (identical for roots & ECM)
rd <- D * N_s / u_c       # m

###
### ROOT PARAMETERS
###

# Average biomass when needed
B_root_average = 2.8      # kg
B_myco_average = 2.8      # kg

# ECM defaults (replace with literature)
myco_diameter <- 8e-6     # m (8 microns)
myco_density  <- 400      # kg m-3
myco_length   <- 4e-6     # m

# Root architecture
n <- 1e5                  # number of roots per crown area
l <- 1.5                  # average root length (mm or m depending on your model)

###
### EXTRA PARAMETERS
###

k9 <- 0.01                # nitrogen gate parameter
k8 <- 2.7                 # uptake-age parameter (years)

mycorrhized   <- 0.9      # 90% colonisation
investment_m  <- 0.3      # fungi return 30% of N to host

traits <- list(
  k_1 = 0.25,      # diameter scaling (mm * sqrt(m))  → adjust for your species
  k_2 = 0.15,      # cortex scaling 1
  k_3 = 0.02,      # cortex scaling 2
  k_4 = 350,       # cortical density (kg m-3)
  k_5 = 150,       # stele density (kg m-3)
  k_6 = 4,         # max lifespan (years)
  k_7 = 120        # lifespan sensitivity to diameter
)


```

## Equtaions

```{r}

############################################################
## ROOT ARCHITECTURE FUNCTIONS (R translation of C++)
############################################################

root_diameter <- function(root_length, traits) {
  traits$k_1 / sqrt(root_length)
}

root_density <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  pct_cortex <- (traits$k_2 + traits$k_3 / d)^2
  traits$k_4 * pct_cortex + traits$k_5
}

root_lifespan <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  traits$k_6 * (1 - exp(-traits$k_7 * d))
}

root_mass <- function(root_length, root_no, crown_area, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  rho <- root_density(root_length, traits)
  
  rho * (d/2)^2 * root_length * pi * root_no * 1e-9 * crown_area
}


############################################################
## 1. SOIL EXPLORATION PER BIOMASS (e_u)
############################################################

e_u_root <- function(rd, root_diameter, root_density) {
  4 * rd^2 / (root_density * root_diameter^2)
}

e_u_myco <- function(rd, myco_diameter, myco_density) {
  4 * rd^2 / (myco_density * myco_diameter^2)
}


############################################################
## 2. CROWDING TERMS
############################################################

effective_biomass <- function(B_root, B_myco, e_root, e_myco) {
  B_root + B_myco * (e_myco / e_root)
}

Bs_total <- function(N_s, n, l, myco_rho, L_hypha, D, u_c, e_root, e_myco, traits) {
  
  # root radius based on N_s, D, u_c
  rd <- N_s * D / u_c
  
  # root biomass
  Bs_root <- root_density(l, traits) * pi * rd^2 * l * n
  
  # mycorrhizal biomass
  Bs_myco <- myco_rho * pi * rd^2 * L_hypha
  
  # total biomass scaled by efficiency
  Bs_total <- Bs_root + Bs_myco * (e_myco / e_root)
  
  return(Bs_total)
}


S_crowding <- function(Btot, Bstot) {
  Bstot / (Bstot + Btot)
}


############################################################
## 3. BIOCHEMICAL UPTAKE (CROWDING-LIMITED)
############################################################

U_c <- function(B_i, Sval, Vmax_i) {
  B_i * Sval * Vmax_i
}


############################################################
## 4. NITROGEN AVAILABILITY
############################################################

N_av <- function(e_u_i, N_s) {
  e_u_i * N_s
}


############################################################
## 5. TWO-STEP MICHAELIS–MENTEN
############################################################

U_final <- function(Uc, Nav) {
  (Uc * Nav) / (Uc + Nav)
}


############################################################
## 6. ROOT AND MYCORRHIZAL UPTAKE FUNCTIONS
############################################################

uptake_root <- function(crown_area, B_myco, l, n, traits, myco_diameter, myco_density, myco_length, N_s, u_c, D) {
  
  # --- Root architecture ------------------------------------------
  root_d <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000
  rho_root <- root_density(l, traits)
  
  B_root = root_mass(root_length = l, root_no = n, traits = traits, crown_area = crown_area)
  
  # --- Depletion radius -------------------------------------------
  rd <- D * N_s / u_c
  
  # --- Soil exploration per biomass -------------------------------
  e_root_val <- e_u_root(root_d, rho_root)
  e_myco_val <- e_u_myco(root_d, rho_root)
  
  # --- Effective biomass ------------------------------------------
  Btot <- effective_biomass(B_root, B_myco, e_root_val, e_myco_val)
  
  # --- Saturation biomass -----------------------------------------
  Bs_root <- rho_root * pi * rd^2 * l * n
  Bs_myco <- myco_density * pi * rd^2 * myco_length # TODO: scale wrong
  Bstot <- Bs_total(N_s, myco_density, n, l, D, u_c)
  
  # --- Crowding ---------------------------------------------------
  Sval <- S_crowding(Btot, Bstot)
  
  # --- Biochemical limitation ------------------------------------
  Uc <- U_c(B_root, Sval, u_c)
  
  # --- Nitrogen availability -------------------------------------
  Nav <- N_av(e_root_val, N_s)
  
  # --- Final uptake -----------------------------------------------
  U_final(Uc, Nav)
}


uptake_myco <- function(crown_area, B_myco, l, n, traits, myco_diameter, myco_density, myco_length, N_s, u_c, D) {
  
  # --- Root architecture ------------------------------------------
  root_d <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000
  rho_root <- root_density(l, traits)
  
  B_root = root_mass(root_length = l, root_no = n, traits = traits, crown_area = crown_area)
  
  # --- Depletion radius -------------------------------------------
  rd <- D * N_s / u_c
  
  # --- Soil exploration per biomass -------------------------------
  e_root_val <- e_u_root(root_d, rho_root)
  e_myco_val <- e_u_myco(root_d, rho_root)
  
  # --- Effective biomass ------------------------------------------
  Btot <- effective_biomass(B_root, B_myco, e_root_val, e_myco_val)
  
  # --- Saturation biomass -----------------------------------------
  Bs_root <- rho_root * pi * rd^2 * l * n
  Bs_myco <- myco_density * pi * rd^2 * myco_length # TODO: scale wrong
  Bstot <- Bs_total(N_s, myco_density, n, l, D, u_c)
  
  # --- Crowding ---------------------------------------------------
  Sval <- S_crowding(Btot, Bstot)
  
  # --- Biochemical limitation ------------------------------------
  Uc <- U_c(B_myco, Sval, u_c)
  
  # --- Nitrogen availability -------------------------------------
  Nav <- N_av(e_myco_val, N_s)
  
  # --- Final uptake -----------------------------------------------
  U_final(Uc, Nav)
}


uptake_myco <- function(B_myco, B_root, l, traits, myco_diameter, myco_density, N_s, u_c, D) {
  
  # --- Root architecture ------------------------------------------
  root_d <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000
  rho_root <- root_density(l, traits)
  
  # --- Depletion radius -------------------------------------------
  rd <- N_s * D / u_c
  
  # --- Soil exploration per biomass -------------------------------
  e_root_val <- e_u_root(root_d, rho_root)
  e_myco_val <- e_u_myco(root_d, rho_root)
  
  # --- Effective biomass ------------------------------------------
  Btot <- effective_biomass(B_root, B_myco, e_root_val, e_myco_val)
  
  # --- Saturation biomass -----------------------------------------
  Bs_root <- rho_root * pi * rd^2
  Bs_myco <- myco_density * pi * rd^2
  Bstot <- Bs_total(N_s, myco_density, n, l, D, u_c)
  
  # --- Crowding saturation ----------------------------------------
  Sval <- S_crowding(Btot, Bstot)
  
  # --- Biochemical limitation ------------------------------------
  Uc <- U_c(B_myco, Sval, u_c)
  
  # --- Nitrogen availability -------------------------------------
  Nav <- N_av(e_myco_val, N_s)
  
  # --- Final uptake -----------------------------------------------
  U_final(Uc, Nav)
}

############################################################
## 7. AGE EFFECT AND N GATE
############################################################

uptake_age <- function(age) {
  1 / (1 + exp(age - k8))
}

nitrogen_gate <- function(n, length, diameter) {
  SA <- n * pi * diameter * length
  SA / (SA + k9)
}


############################################################
## 8. COMBINED PLANT UPTAKE
############################################################

plant_uptake <- function(N_s,
                         crown_area,
                         B_myco,
                         l,
                         n_root,
                         traits,
                         mycorrhized,
                         investment_m,
                         age,
                         myco_diameter,
                         myco_density,
                         myco_length,
                         u_c,
                         D) {
  
  # --- Root uptake ---------------------------------------------------
  Uroot <- uptake_root(crown_area = crown_area,
                       B_myco = B_myco,
                       l = l,
                       n = n_root,
                       traits = traits,
                       myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
                       myco_density = myco_density,
                       myco_length = myco_length,
                       N_s = N_s,
                       u_c = u_c,
                       D = D)
  
  # --- Mycorrhizal uptake -------------------------------------------
  Um <- uptake_myco(crown_area = crown_area,
                     B_myco = B_myco,
                     l = l,
                     n = n_root,
                     traits = traits,
                     myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
                     myco_density = myco_density,
                     myco_length = myco_length,
                     N_s = N_s,
                     u_c = u_c,
                     D = D)
  
  # --- Gate & age effects -------------------------------------------
  root_d <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000  # root diameter in meters
  gate <- nitrogen_gate(n_root, l, root_d)
  age_factor <- uptake_age(age)
  
  # --- Total plant uptake -------------------------------------------
  age_factor * (
    (1 - mycorrhized) * Uroot +
      mycorrhized * gate * investment_m * Um
  )
}


```

## e_u plots

```{r}
root_d <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000  # m
root_rho <- root_density(l, traits)
myco_d <- myco_diameter                     # m
myco_rho <- myco_density

# Test multiple N_s values
N_s_vals <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1)   # example: kg N m⁻³

# --- 1. e_u vs D ----------------------------------------------------
D_vals <- 10^seq(-10, -8, length.out = 50)
u_c_fixed <- 2e-8

e_D <- expand_grid(D = D_vals, N_s = N_s_vals) %>%
  mutate(
    rd = N_s * D / u_c_fixed,
    e_root = e_u_root(rd, root_d, root_rho),
    e_myco = e_u_myco(rd, myco_d, myco_rho)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(e_root, e_myco),
    names_to = "Component",
    values_to = "e_u"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Var = "Diffusion coefficient (D)", Var_val = D)

# --- 2. e_u vs u_c --------------------------------------------------
u_c_vals <- 10^seq(-9, -7, length.out = 50)
D_fixed <- 1e-9

e_uc <- expand_grid(u_c = u_c_vals, N_s = N_s_vals) %>%
  mutate(
    rd = N_s * D_fixed / u_c,
    e_root = e_u_root(rd, root_d, root_rho),
    e_myco = e_u_myco(rd, myco_d, myco_rho)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(e_root, e_myco),
    names_to = "Component",
    values_to = "e_u"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Var = "Uptake capacity (u_c)", Var_val = u_c)

# --- Combine -------------------------------------------------------
e_all <- bind_rows(e_D, e_uc)

# --- Plot -----------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(e_all, aes(x = Var_val, y = e_u, colour = as.factor(N_s))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Var), cols = vars(Component), scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Variable value",
    y = expression(e[u] ~ "(m"^3 * " kg"^-1 * ")"),
    colour = expression(N[s] ~ "(kg ~ N ~ m"^-3 * ")"),
    title = "Soil exploration efficiency e_u vs D and u_c"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
        legend.position = "bottom")


```


## Plots, Crowding Saturation S(B_tot)

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameter ranges and defaults
# ------------------------------------------------------------
N_s_vals <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5)

param_grid <- list(
  l             = seq(0.1, 1.0, length.out = 10),
  n             = seq(1e5, 1e7, length.out = 10),
  myco_diameter = seq(8e-5, 8e-7, length.out = 10),
  myco_rho      = seq(300, 500, length.out = 10),
  L_hypha       = seq(4e-6, 4e-8, length.out = 10)
)

defaults <- list(
  l             = 1.5,
  n             = 1e5,
  myco_diameter = 8e-5,
  myco_rho      = 400,
  L_hypha       = 4e-6
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute Bstot and crowding saturation for a given parameter
# ------------------------------------------------------------
make_curve_data <- function(param_name, param_value, N_s) {

  # assign parameters
  l             <- if (param_name == "l")             param_value else defaults$l
  n             <- if (param_name == "n")             param_value else defaults$n
  myco_diameter <- if (param_name == "myco_diameter") param_value else defaults$myco_diameter
  myco_rho      <- if (param_name == "myco_rho")      param_value else defaults$myco_rho
  L_hypha       <- if (param_name == "L_hypha")       param_value else defaults$L_hypha

  # root demand
  rd <- N_s * D / u_c   # make sure D and u_c are defined

  # biomass components
  root_mass_val <- root_mass(l, n, crown_area = 1, traits)
  myco_mass_val <- myco_rho * pi * (myco_diameter/2)^2 * L_hypha

  # efficiencies
  e_root_val <- e_u_root(rd, root_diameter(l, traits)/1000, root_density(l, traits))
  e_myco_val <- e_u_myco(rd, myco_diameter, myco_rho)

  # total biomass saturation
  Bstot <- Bs_total(N_s, n, l, myco_rho, L_hypha, D, u_c, e_root_val, e_myco_val, traits)
  B_effect <- effective_biomass(root_mass_val, myco_mass_val, e_root_val, e_myco_val)

  # effective biomass — generate sequence from 0 to current B_effect for plotting S(B)
  S_seq <- S_crowding(B_effect, Bstot)

  # return as data.frame
  data.frame(
    param      = param_name,
    x          = param_value,
    N_s        = N_s,
    B_effect   = B_effect,
    Bstot      = Bstot,
    S_crowding = S_seq
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate full dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------
df_results <- map_df(names(param_grid), function(param_name) {
  map_df(param_grid[[param_name]], function(param_value) {
    map_df(N_s_vals, function(N_s) {
      make_curve_data(param_name, param_value, N_s)
    })
  })
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plotting function: two stacked panels per parameter
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_param <- function(param_name, log_x = FALSE) {
  
  dfp <- df_results %>% filter(param == param_name)
  
  scale_x <- if(log_x) scale_x_log10() else NULL

  # Panel 1: Crowding saturation vs parameter
  p1 <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = x, y = S_crowding, color = factor(N_s))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste("Crowding saturation vs", param_name),
         x = param_name,
         y = "Crowding saturation",
         color = "N_s") +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_x

  # Panel 2: Bstot vs parameter
  p2 <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = x, y = Bstot, color = factor(N_s))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste("Bstot vs", param_name),
         x = param_name,
         y = "Bstot (kg C)",
         color = "N_s") +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_x

  p1 / p2  # stack panels vertically
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Example usage
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_param("l", log_x = FALSE)
plot_param("n", log_x = TRUE)
plot_param("myco_diameter", log_x = TRUE)
plot_param("myco_rho", log_x = FALSE)
plot_param("L_hypha", log_x = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate plots for all parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------
B_seq <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)
S_seq <- S_crowding(B_seq, 0.5)

plot(B_seq, S_seq, xlab = "Biomass", ylab = "Saturation")

``` 

## Plot 2 — Root Uptake vs Soil Nitrogen Nₛ

```{r}

# Plot 2: Two-step Michaelis-Menten uptake vs soil N
Nseq <- seq(0.0001, 0.01, length.out = 200)  # soil N range (kg N m-3)

# Compute dynamic root parameters
root_d <- root_diameter(l, traits)
root_rho <- root_density(l, traits)

Uptake_values <- sapply(Nseq, function(N_s_i) {
  
  uptake_root(
    B_root = root_mass(l, n, crown_area = 1, traits),  # dynamic root biomass
    B_myco = B_myco_average,                           # or dynamic myco mass if desired
    l = l,
    traits = traits,
    myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
    myco_density = myco_density,
    N_s = N_s_i,
    u_c = u_c,
    D = D
  )
})

df2 <- data.frame(N_s = Nseq, Uptake = Uptake_values)

ggplot(df2, aes(x = N_s, y = Uptake)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, color = "forestgreen") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil N concentration N_s (kg N m⁻³)",
    y = "Root uptake (kg N)",
    title = "Root Nitrogen Uptake vs Soil N Availability"
  ) +
  theme_classic()


```

```{r}
# Create individual data frames for plotting
df_root <- data.frame(N_s = Nseq, Uptake = Uroot_vals)
df_myco <- data.frame(N_s = Nseq, Uptake = Umyco_vals)
df_whole <- data.frame(N_s = Nseq, Uptake = Uwhole_vals)

# Plot Root Uptake
p_root <- ggplot(df_root, aes(x = N_s, y = Uptake)) +
  geom_line(color = "forestgreen", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Root Nitrogen Uptake", x = "Soil N (kg N m⁻³)", y = "Uptake (kg N)") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")

# Plot Mycorrhizal Uptake
p_myco <- ggplot(df_myco, aes(x = N_s, y = Uptake)) +
  geom_line(color = "sienna", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Nitrogen Uptake", x = "Soil N (kg N m⁻³)", y = "Uptake (kg N)") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")

# Plot Whole-Plant Uptake
p_whole <- ggplot(df_whole, aes(x = N_s, y = Uptake)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Whole-Plant Nitrogen Uptake", x = "Soil N (kg N m⁻³)", y = "Uptake (kg N)") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")

# Optionally, display them together (requires patchwork package)
library(patchwork)
p_root / p_myco / p_whole


```
